evidence_labels.MEASURED: Original image dimensions, hashes and decoded pixel samples.
evidence_labels.PROPOSED: Originally drafted/refined visual rules; accepted by human for V1 visual-input scope. This does not create measured technical tolerances or production approval.

projection.reference_caveat: Town and distant scenery contain converging/eye-level perspective; borrow mood/material, not camera geometry.

runtime_classification.preferred_phrase: 2D runtime with 2.5D presentation, Elevated 3/4, Soft Isometric-Lite

alpha_observation.note: Visible checkerboard is encoded in sampled RGB with alpha 250; this board is not a clean production effect export.

palette.method: Decoded RGB values in original PNGs; median of 9x9 patches or exact selected original pixel. No ICC conversion or de-lighting. Coordinate origin top-left; x increases right and y down.

entries.common_usage: Paper and quiet panel centers; related plaster surface.
entries.variation_guidance: Warm off-whites with restrained mottling; plaster comparison #F3DEC7 at cafe_architecture (632,392), same median method.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: Do not turn every object into cream or bake warm atmosphere.

entries.common_usage: Stone, gravel and warm neutral transitions.
entries.variation_guidance: Permit grayer stone and pale gravel from category reference; swatch is a warm anchor, not all stone shades.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No orange wash over all stone.

entries.common_usage: Dark equipment, trim and restrained metal.
entries.variation_guidance: Brown-gray near-dark variation; retain readable form.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No pure-black heavy outline or glossy chrome default.

entries.common_usage: Wood light planes and modest edge highlights.
entries.variation_guidance: Local grain can vary inside the cedar relationship.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No white plastic specular band.

entries.variation_guidance: Warm brown/honey variation; use light/dark partners.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No orange saturation across all wood.

entries.variation_guidance: Allow subdued brown shade, distinct from metal.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No baked long cast shadow.

entries.variation_guidance: Broken leaf/grass highlights; do not cover every ground cell.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No luminous lime carpet.

entries.variation_guidance: Muted olive-to-green variation.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No green tint on every material.

entries.common_usage: Muted leaf variation and restrained fabric/UI accents.
entries.variation_guidance: Stay subdued relative to rewards and actor.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No dominant saturated jade theme.

entries.variation_guidance: Species variation allowed with shared hierarchy.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No identical stamped leaf detail everywhere.

entries.variation_guidance: Subdued green shadows; keep actor silhouettes clear.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No black wall of foreground vegetation.

entries.variation_guidance: Soft blue-green variation; foam can borrow cream.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No neon cyan or global glossy sheen.

entries.variation_guidance: Blue-green with localized current marks.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No saturated swimming-pool blue over all rivers.

entries.variation_guidance: Muted darker blue-green; not a nav/depth measurement.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No black water trough or baked scene shadow.

entries.common_usage: Noren, textiles and restrained roof/UI accents.
entries.variation_guidance: Blue-gray/indigo family; dark roof also permits charcoal gray.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No blue covering every roof/UI frame.

entries.variation_guidance: Pale warm tones; switched illumination is separate runtime work.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No always-on amber halo on all props.

entries.variation_guidance: Restrained gold body and brighter transient highlight.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No routine gold spectacle for all interactions.

entries.variation_guidance: Soft coral/pink; distinguish from character scarf authority.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No red flood or combat-hit language.

entries.variation_guidance: Pale pink variation with foliage context.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No pink forest in every season/district.

entries.variation_guidance: Warm oranges with quieter neighbors.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No universal autumn tint or actor palette replacement.

entries.variation_guidance: Muted blue/violet variation.
entries.prohibited_dominant_misuse: No violet glow or blue flowers on every component.

role_evaluation.restrained_jade: Muted green fabrics/UI are present; no distinct jade anchor or dominant jade requirement is established. Use existing moss/sage relationships only.
role_evaluation.warm_neutral: Shares warm_stone; lighter cream surfaces remain a separate relationship.
role_evaluation.aged_dark_metal: Shares charcoal_brown, not a separate bright accent.

palette.variation_policy: Anchors describe relationships, not pixel-exact painting constraints. Reference render colors are not measured material albedo.

materials.texture_density: Visible broad grain with a few knots; denser recesses, quieter boards.
materials.edge_treatment: Defined warm edges; modest rounded wear.
materials.highlight_character: Matte light plane, restrained grain highlight.
materials.local_contrast: Local construction contrast; no deep global cast shadow.
materials.prohibited_traits: Plastic gloss, photoreal wood scans, carved detail on every surface.

materials.edge_treatment: Clean architectural boundaries with mild chipped softness.
materials.prohibited_traits: Busy noise, pure-white sheen, dramatic sunset bake.

materials.texture_density: Readable tile rows grouped at gameplay scale.
materials.local_contrast: Roof shape stronger than individual tile scratches.
materials.prohibited_traits: Photoreal specular tile grids or strict diamond geometry imposed on Home.

materials.texture_density: Faceted painted planes and sparse cracks.
materials.prohibited_traits: Uniform rectangular blocks for every natural bank.

materials.texture_density: Grouped small stones with quieter open ground.
materials.local_contrast: Low contrast under paths and actors.

materials.texture_density: Mostly quiet glaze with occasional painted motif.
materials.prohibited_traits: Glossy 3D reflections or motifs on every bowl.

materials.edge_treatment: Stable text-safe centers and readable corners.
materials.prohibited_traits: Crumpled/torn text centers or literal cardboard world rendering.

materials.texture_density: Grouped weave with simplified small-scale detail.
materials.local_contrast: Weave darker than surrounding face but not dominant.
materials.prohibited_traits: Every strand modeled at thumbnail scale.

materials.texture_density: Leaf clusters grouped around large canopy masses.
materials.edge_treatment: Organic broken silhouette with clear major shape.
materials.prohibited_traits: Uniform leaf stamps or pulsating canopy scale.
Dense detailed grass on every walkable cell.
Every shrub covered in high-contrast flowers.
Uniform animated shimmer, neon cyan, baked directional scene reflections.
Chrome/PBR render or gold plating on ordinary equipment.

edge_language.silhouette: Readable painted boundary; architectural edges firmer than vegetation.
edge_language.outer_line: Thin warm/dark selective contour; avoid uniform heavy black outline.
edge_language.internal_lines: Sparse construction/character cues, reduced at gameplay size.
edge_language.organic_irregularity: Clustered foliage, modest handmade material variation.
edge_language.brush_texture: Visible but controlled; no blurry watercolor wash or microdetail everywhere.

lighting_policy.neutral_source_assumption: Soft broadly neutral illumination; local form shading retained without a chosen time of day.
lighting_policy.reference_deviation: Warm scene illumination and lit lantern halos are contextual reference evidence, not reusable source templates.

shadow_policy.contact_shadow: Separate registered contact shadow where appropriate; small restrained construction shading may remain intrinsic.
shadow_policy.forbidden: Heavy universal drop shadows and long baked directional casts.

depth_language.actor_occlusion: must not become a gameplay occluder by visual inference
only through approved registered depth roles

depth_language.detail: rich grouped environment; quiet travel/contact areas
depth_language.actor_occlusion: moving actor must remain legible through layer crossings

depth_language.contrast: framing, never a competing black mass
depth_language.actor_occlusion: controlled partial overlap; no unreadable traversal or borrowed photographic blur

detail_hierarchy.status: Human-approved relative tiers; no numeric density threshold

environment_language.density_rule: Quiet navigation/contact areas between localized plants and architectural richness.

architecture_language.accent_policy: Muted indigo textiles, moss/sage fabric and small flowers; jade is not dominant.
architecture_language.registration_caveat: Illustrated modules are not connector/aperture/interior-shell evidence.

character_authority.master: Locked orange protagonist master; not supplied in this reference directory. Exact approved master ID/hash must be resolved before future character generation.
character_authority.exploration_authority: motion language and rendering compatibility only
locked_traits: asymmetric ears: upright attentive / softer relaxed
observed_drift: tail thickness/length and cream tip vary

character_motion_language.static_reference_limit: Poses do not establish clip maps, direction completeness, frame order, root locks or timing.

symbolic_resource_language.boundary: Do not use symbolic icon scale/glow as physical world-prop registration.

ui_language.detail: lower than environment; quiet text-safe centers
ui_language.ornament: corners/edges only, selected exceptions for feature/reward panels
ui_language.bar_rule: Frame and dynamic fill separate; no dynamic values baked into background.
ui_language.nine_slice: Stable corners, simple sides, stretch-safe center; board is not a sliced production export.

vfx_language.cool_color: Soft sky/indigo/river blue-green; reduce neon cyan.
vfx_language.source_rule: Transparent effect-only production source; blend mode in metadata; checkerboard/black/dark backgrounds are preview-only.
vfx_language.board_refinement: Reduce routine starbursts, gold steam, green upgrade glow and blue cleaning sparkle intensity.

ambient_motion_language.tree: slow organic foliage-led canopy sway; stable trunk/root/baseline; no whole-sprite scale pulse
ambient_motion_language.phase: offset/random start where appropriate; authored easing and stable anchors
ambient_motion_language.timing_values: UNMEASURED; static boards do not validate timing or loop quality

semantic_examples.coffee_completed: steam + restrained sparkle + small object response
semantic_examples.relationship_up: soft heart trail + warm UI accent

feedback_language.binding: Conceptual names only; bind later to existing approved event IDs without creating gameplay semantics.

generation_consistency.seed: Provider/model/version-specific reproducibility metadata; never cross-provider identity authority.
generation_consistency.rights_rule: Must be permitted for exact inputs/use; selected reference status does not grant conditioning rights.

godot_compatibility.target: Godot 4.7.2 as specified by project task; no runtime test performed here
godot_compatibility.binding: Existing semantic anchors/events only; no navigation/collision/world changes.

diorama_interpretation: Illustrated living diorama: layered silhouettes, tactile painted surfaces and clear overlap; no literal cardboard/cutout outlines or heavy drop shadows.
prohibited_traits: symbolic rewards used as physical props
allowed_variation: individual cats within their approved masters

human_review.timestamp_basis: Recording time from host clock; not a signed review timestamp.
accepted_direction: cedar / cream plaster / moss / sage / river blue-green language
canonical orange protagonist remains separate identity authority
world props separated from symbolic resource visuals
human_review.authentication_boundary: This records the explicit human conversation decision for style visual-input use. No credential, signature or Phase 0 production approval envelope was supplied or fabricated. It cannot satisfy authenticated production approval or authorize publication.
human_review.notes: Visual contents, palette, reference identities and all documented refinements/limitations are unchanged. Approval metadata is promoted to version 1.0.0; the exact reviewed candidate artifacts are identified above.

known_limitations: No gameplay-camera/mobile-scale render or moving-actor proof performed.
No canonical protagonist master in permitted directory; textual identity preserved, no direct master comparison.
Still boards cannot validate authored timing, root drift, seams, clip semantics or direction coverage.
Selected PNG provenance/conditioning rights not independently resolved by this visual audit.
Town/depth atmospheric lighting, blur and perspective must not be copied into modular sources.
VFX board is not clean effect-only alpha source.
Human style acceptance is recorded for MVP visual input only; no authenticated production approval envelope or publication authorization exists.

tree_mvp_visual_input.scope: Human-approved visual input for future Asset Factory MVP and Animated Environment Tree MVP; no tree generation/implementation or production publication authorization.
remaining_stage_requirements: separate explicit authorization before tree generation or MVP implementation
